title: Listening Drill — School parcel collections — Booking
description: Phone booking. One synthetic recording, six questions. Recommended time: 7 minutes.

sections.title: School parcel collections — Booking
sections.transcript:
CALLER: Good morning. I’m enquiring about school parcel collections. I missed the last date and I’m hoping there are still places.

ADVISER: I’m Ravi; ask for me if you need to change your booking. The first available place is at nine o’clock. The earlier group is full.

CALLER: Could I bring a colleague? Where should we register when we arrive?

ADVISER: This group has a limit of eight people, so please book for anyone coming with you. Sign the register in the parcel room. Do not wait outside with the previous group.

CALLER: Thank you. Is there somebody who can explain what we’ll be doing?

ADVISER: For questions about the activity itself, speak to the collection clerk rather than the bookings team. I’ll attach a blank dispatch note to the confirmation email; there is no need to print it.
